cases.name: mkdir through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; mkdir la/new; ls d

cases.name: mkdir -p through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; mkdir -p la/x/y; ls d/x

cases.name: a write through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > la/f; cat d/f

cases.name: an append through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > d/f; echo y >> la/f; cat d/f

cases.name: a write through a link to a file
args: echo x > t; ln -s t l; echo y > l; cat t

cases.name: cp into a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > s; cp s la/c; cat d/c

cases.name: cp -r into a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; mkdir s; echo x > s/f; cp -r s la/c; cat d/c/f

cases.name: mv into a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > s; mv s la/m; cat d/m

cases.name: mv out of a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > d/f; mv la/f out; cat out

cases.name: chmod through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > d/f; chmod 600 la/f; stat -c %a d/f

cases.name: chmod through a link to a file
args: echo x > t; ln -s t l; chmod 600 l; stat -c %a t

cases.name: a link made in a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; ln -s target la/l; readlink d/l

cases.name: a hard link made in a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > s; ln s la/h; cat d/h

cases.name: readlink through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; ln -s t d/l; readlink la/l

cases.name: rm through a linked folder
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; echo x > d/f; rm la/f; ls d

cases.name: find a linked folder with a slash
args: mkdir d; ln -s d la; touch d/x; find la/

cases.name: find a folder with a slash
args: mkdir d; touch d/x; find d/

cases.name: readlink -f through a dot link
args: mkdir d; ln -s . d/self; touch d/f; readlink -f d/self/f | sed "s|^$PWD/||"

cases.name: readlink -f through two links
args: mkdir -p a/b; ln -s a/b c; ln -s c e; touch a/b/f; readlink -f e/f | sed "s|^$PWD/||"

cases.name: ls -l modes
args: mkdir d; echo x > d/f; chmod 600 d/f; echo y > d/x; chmod 755 d/x; mkdir d/sub; chmod 700 d/sub; ls -l d | tail -n +2 | awk '{print $1, $NF}'

cases.name: ls -l a link
args: echo x > f; ln -s f l; ls -l l | awk '{print substr($1, 1, 1), $(NF-2), $(NF-1), $NF}'

cases.name: ** after a folder
args: mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/g; echo a/**

cases.name: ** after a folder under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/g; echo a/**

cases.name: ** alone under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/g; echo **

cases.name: ** then a name under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/f; echo a/**/f

cases.name: ** after an absolute folder
args: mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/g; echo "$PWD"/a/** | sed "s|$PWD/||g"

cases.name: ** after an absolute folder under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b/c; touch a/b/c/f a/g; echo "$PWD"/a/** | sed "s|$PWD/||g"

cases.name: a write to a looping link
args: ln -s l l; echo y > l; echo rc=$?

cases.name: an append to a looping link
args: ln -s l l; echo y >> l; echo rc=$?

cases.name: a write through a looping link
args: ln -s l l; echo y > l/f; echo rc=$?

cases.name: stderr to a looping link
args: ln -s l l; ls nowhere 2> l; echo rc=$?

cases.name: printf -v with UTF-8 bytes
args: printf -v x '\xc3\xa9 \xe2\x9c\x93 \xf0\x9f\x98\x80'; echo "$x" > f; cat f

cases.name: printf -v into an array with UTF-8 bytes
ls -ld a linked folder with a slash
args: mkdir d; chmod 750 d; ln -s d l; ls -ld l/ | awk '{print $1, $NF}'; ls -ld l | awk '{print substr($1, 1, 1), $(NF-2), $(NF-1), $NF}'

cases.name: ls -dF a linked folder with a slash
args: mkdir d; ln -s d l; ls -dF l/ l; ls -ldF l/ | awk '{print $1, $NF}'

cases.name: **/ under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b .h/i; touch a/b/f a/g; echo **/; echo a/**/; shopt -s dotglob; echo **/
cases.stdout:
a/ a/b/
a/ a/b/
.h/ .h/i/ a/ a/b/

cases.name: **/** under globstar
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b; touch a/b/f a/g; echo a/**/**; echo **/**; echo a/**/**/; echo **/b/**
cases.stdout:
a a/b a/b/f a/g
a a/b a/b/f a/g
a/ a/b/
a/b a/b/f

cases.name: **/ names a linked folder
args: shopt -s globstar; mkdir -p a/b; touch a/b/f; ln -s b a/lb; ln -s b/f a/lf; echo **/; echo a/**
cases.stdout:
a/ a/b/ a/lb/
a/ a/b a/b/f a/lb a/lf
